role: Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs
organization: Government of France (Barnier, Bayrou, Lecornu governments)
description: Head of the Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (Quai d'Orsay), retained across successive governments including after the 26 February 2026 reshuffle under PM Sébastien Lecornu.

role: President of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the National Assembly
description: Chaired the Foreign Affairs Committee of the National Assembly following the 2024 snap legislative election, until his appointment as Foreign Minister.
Minister Delegate for European Affairs, attached to Foreign Minister Stéphane Séjourné.

role: Minister Delegate for the Digital Transition and Telecommunications
description: Minister Delegate for the Digital Transition and Telecommunications; oversaw digital regulation including the loi visant à sécuriser et réguler l'espace numérique (SREN).

role: Member of the National Assembly (Député), Yvelines 2nd constituency
description: MP for the 2nd constituency of Yvelines, first elected in 2017 and re-elected in 2022 (and an October 2022 by-election) and 2024. Served as Vice-President of the Finance Committee. Mandate suspended while serving as a minister, with a substitute (suppléant) sitting in his place.

role: Member of the Regional Council of Île-de-France
description: Regional councillor elected on the La République En Marche! list led by Laurent Saint-Martin in the 2021 regional election. HATVP records the mandate ending in October 2025.

role: Secretary General, then Vice-President, of the Mouvement Démocrate (MoDem)
description: Party spokesperson (2018), Secretary General of the MoDem (Dec 2018–July 2022) under François Bayrou, then Vice-President from July 2022.

role: Departmental councillor of Haute-Loire (canton of Yssingeaux)
description: Departmental councillor for the canton of Yssingeaux, a seat his father Jacques Barrot had held until 2004; resigned in 2017.

role: Associate Professor of Finance (assistant then associate professor)
description: Faculty member in finance at HEC Paris (on leave of absence while in government). HATVP declaration records teaching/research income from HEC Paris through July 2022.

Taught finance at the MIT Sloan School of Management; research on finance, production networks and evaluation of business-support policies, published in journals including the Quarterly Journal of Economics, Journal of Financial Economics and Management Science.
